title: Very disappointed!
text:
Very disappointed!. This Kwasyo Food Dehydrator Machine says it is fast. Fast it is not! I have a different kind of dehydrator, when I put food on it at night I get up in the morning and it has finished. This machine however was not like that at all. I peeled, cored, and thinly sliced my apples as the instructions suggested. I set or tried to set the temperature as directed. The instructions said to set at 65 degrees for 6-8 hours. Longer timing makes it crisp. First of all, the machine would not go down to 65 degrees. So I looked at the top of the machine and used the instructions for fruit. I had to reset the timer several times for my apples to be completely dehydrated.

The machine itself is nice. It has 6 trays to put your food for dehydrating. It does run very quietly and I did run it at night. There is an instruction booklet with the machine but as mentioned above it was incorrect about the temperature and the time. I will be experimenting with different foods and writing down the times and temperatures for my personal use. I was very disappointed with this machine.

I will not be recommending this Kwasyo Food Dehydrator Machine to friends and family.
